name: Mend Flesh's Damage 25+ discount and Recover 8
notes: Mend Flesh is an EXIA (advanced element) ACTION card, so the starting champion's Subcards are patched with a real EXIA champion (Dante, Hemomancer) to unlock element access. The starting champion's Damage is pre-set to 25 to both reach the [Damage 25+] discount condition and make the unconditional Recover 8 observable as a Damage decrease. The discount reduces the 2-reserve cost to 0, so no reserve payment decisions are needed.

rulesClauses: [Damage 25+] This card costs 2 less to activate.
